rule.statement: A court must consider the fact that a property has been assessed and rates paid for it, when determining prescriptive title.
rule.supporting_quote: Hon. PHC has failed to take cognizance of the fact that the learned Additional District Judge of Colombo has erred in coming to the conclusion that no specific assessment for the identical plot of land, whereas in fact the said 6.51 perch land has been assessed in 1995 as 25/1 Swasthika Gardens, Peliyagoda, and rates had been paid from 1995
